snippet.title: SPACE MANAGER 🛰️ Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Space Manager launches on October 12, 2026! 🚀

Build your own space program, plan your missions, manage your resources, and take your operation beyond Earth. 

⭐ Wishlist Space Manager on Steam and be ready for launch: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4229480/Space_Manager/

Can’t wait until October? You don’t have to.

🎮 Play the free demo now on Steam and start building your space program today.

The countdown has officially begun. See you at launch! 

#SpaceManager #StrategyGame #SpaceGame #Steam #ManagerGames
